lines.t: I have written it on tablets of stone, and within the heart of man, and within the pages
of my book it is made plain, thus they are without excuse.
For I am God alone, the righteous one
I alone am holy, just and good
I alone have divided right from wrong
I alone have established the law and defined what is sin
Behold, I expose the darkness and bring all hidden things into the light
For I alone sit as judge, the only faithful and true witness
Says the Lord
Created in you
Trust in me and you shall be set free
For it is the humble penitent man who shall see God
Behold, you shall look upon my face as I restore him in my image
For I am the image of the invisible God
The perfect reflection of the Father
The face of the Majesty from on high, Emmanuel
Therefore open your heart to me
And I shall create you anew
Says the Lord Yahushua
The only faithful and true witness
